create_SegmentationModelConfig: create a SegmentationModelConfig with custom chunk duration, max speakers, and warm-up settings
build_SegmentationModel: build a SegmentationModel from a SegmentationModelConfig for speaker diarization training
create_from_pyannote_model: create a SegmentationModel by copying weights and architecture from a pre-trained pyannote model
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the SegmentationModel with waveforms and optional labels to get logits and loss
convert_to_pyannote_model: convert a SegmentationModel back to a pyannote PyanNet segmentation model for use in pyannote pipelines
